defect: reset polarity flips at a hierarchy boundary
rationale: The child treats child_reset_ni as active-low, but the parent inversion asserts it whenever the top-level active-low reset is asserted and deasserts it during reset operation.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

mutation.description: Inserted an inversion on an active-low reset while preserving the child's active-low port contract.

labels.note: An active-low parent reset is inverted into an active-low child port, reversing assertion and normal operation.
